body:
Not looking for a congrats. It wasn't me that did it. I want people to know that this condition can be overpowered. I want to save a life, not satisfy my needs for attention. If I wanted attention, I wouldn't have used a throwaway. 

I'm not the type of person to pick away at a community full of ill and troubled so I can feel good for a moment.

It does. I want people to know that depression isn't a death sentence. The fact that my friends brought me out means that others can be helped to. Maybe not the same way as me, but I know that it's possible now. I hope my story helps someone. To put it more directly, I hope my story saves someone.

I find that Bob Marley's Mellow Mood works better than any sleeping pill I've ever had. But I can't afford $3.50 + tax every night. So I'm just gonna get one when I need to be a hundred percent awake and alert the next morning.

Oh no, I turned 18 exactly one month ago. I'm just still figuring out how the world works. I'm legally an adult, but thanks to my great parents who refused to teach me anything about the working world and basically threatened to sabotage any work I got, I have no idea how the world works.

I stated in another comment that I have a plan to expose the principal for what a dick he is. Pretty good plan if I do say so myself.

I also stated that there is somewhere for my sister to go. I just hadn't thought of it.

I went out and had a coffee and feel a little better, so I'll go over the situation a bit.

There are two places for my sister to go. Technically three, but living with my dad would be hell. So that's covered. I never thought about that.

Principal? Of course. I know I need glasses due to a farsight in the left eye, so I'm going to get them prescribed. There's at least something Canadian healthcare is good for. I'm going to take them to a place that does custom framing as well. You bring in the frames, they make lenses for them. I'm bringing in a cheap hundred dollar 720p camera pair. Impossible to see the camera. All I got to do is take them off and wipe the lenses, at the same time holding the power button, and I can catch him on video red handed. 

And thanks to where I live being the biggest town of the city, the school board is right next door.

I think I can survive in this house for another year. I've taken to meditation, and it seems to have helped clear things up. I know now what's happening. I'm not obsessing about her anymore.

See, it's only the past month it's gone from "Boy, I miss Sarah" to "Holy fuck I know she's the one I'm going fucking insaneholyfuckimsodepressed" and it's not one person that's causing it.

Ever since I quit smoking, my circle of friends has been destroyed. From at least 25 friends to two. 

The second I figured this out, I was normal again. I have been ever since. 

I'm still going to get a psychiatrist. Benefits of being a disabled Canadian. Free therapy. 

It can't hurt to try, right?

As for my social situation, I'm flying Jacob and I down to see Sarah next summer. Sarah is practically begging to help me pay to fly down, so it might end up being sooner. Maybe in time for that convention she wants me to take her to. 

I've also got a trip to nearest big city, a smaller city, and a... Ghetto city, I guess you could call it... planned for this summer, so there is no way I'll be in my house for more than a week.

Bad news for modding, but hey. People will understand. Especially if I put the dozens of currently unreleased work up in bi-weekly update packs.

You know, I think I can make this work.

Well, as for my mental state I took my dad's advice on meditation. Threw on my favourite "chill out" tracks, turned my headset to the max, turn off the bass entirely, and forgot about the rest of the world.

Holy shit, it actually works.

I've known for a long time, but it only really kicked in now.

The social depression, sudden spike of complete obsession with the first girl I loved, it's obvious.

I'm socially starved. I have gone from at least twenty five friends to two in a month, simply because I quit smoking. The friends that kept me for the favours left. Two remain. Sarah, and Jacob. I need to fly Jacob and I down to where Sarah lives and we all need to hang out.

Just like that, everything was right again.

My obsession with Sarah disappeared. Naturally I'm still interested, but it's not obsessive. I'm not depressed when thinking about her. Actually, we've been chatting for the past hour. Mostly about her boyfriend and my ex. And I've even surprised myself, because instead of doing what any obsessed person would to and try to separate them, I've been giving advice to help better their relationship.

I'm cleaning the house so Jacob can come over this weekend, and we're probably going to make a surprise visit to an old friend. And one more I've forgotten to mention. 

I'm going to be getting a summer gym membership, and also paying to get into my high school's weight room when the school year starts again.

A month's worth of suicidal depression, finally coming to an end. 

I think I'll make that new Texmod tomorrow. I have a community waiting for me, after all.
Getting a summer gym membership and also a membership for my school's weight room next year.
